node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws with the witnesses A,B,k and the two guards established in 1.2 and 1.3. Its polar inverse is the inverse of the same Pi_delta in the root; writing its two components as (u_delta,h_delta), it supplies the asserted C^1 maps, the three exact basepoint identities, and all five displayed approximation/defect estimates with right-hand side A*epsilon_r (with the external lemma's third arbitrary unitary renamed Z).
